description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeRoute via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeRoute spec.

description.description: Immutable. An optional description of this resource. Provide this property when you create the resource.

destRange.description: Immutable. The destination range of outgoing packets that this route applies to. Only IPv4 is supported.

networkRef.description: The network that this route applies to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeNetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/networks/{{networkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeNetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeNetwork resource.

nextHopGateway.description: Immutable. URL to a gateway that should handle matching packets. Currently, you can only specify the internet gateway, using a full or partial valid URL: * 'https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/project/global/gateways/default-internet-gateway' * 'projects/project/global/gateways/default-internet-gateway' * 'global/gateways/default-internet-gateway' * The string 'default-internet-gateway'.

nextHopILBRef.description: A forwarding rule of type loadBalancingScheme=INTERNAL that should handle matching packets.  Note that this can only be used when the destinationRange is a public (non-RFC 1918) IP CIDR range. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeForwardingRule resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/forwardingRules/{{forwardingRuleID}}" or "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/forwardingRules/{{forwardingRuleID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeForwardingRule resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeForwardingRule resource.

nextHopInstanceRef.description: Instance that should handle matching packets. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeInstance resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/zones/{{zone}}/instances/{{instanceID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeInstance resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeInstance resource.

nextHopIp.description: Immutable. Network IP address of an instance that should handle matching packets.

nextHopVPNTunnelRef.description: The ComputeVPNTunnel that should handle matching packets. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `selfLink` field of a `ComputeVPNTunnel` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

priority.description:
Immutable. The priority of this route. Priority is used to break ties in cases
where there is more than one matching route of equal prefix length.

In the case of two routes with equal prefix length, the one with the
lowest-numbered priority value wins.

Default value is 1000. Valid range is 0 through 65535.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

tags.description: Immutable. A list of instance tags to which this route applies.

title: GCP Compute ComputeRoute
